paragraphs.text: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassions,
paragraphs.original: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία πνεύματος, εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί,
paragraphs.translit: Ei tis oun paraklēsis en Christō, ei ti paramythion agapēs, ei tis koinōnia pneumatos, ei tis splanchna kai oiktirmoi,

paragraphs.text: make full my joy, that ye be of the same mind, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
paragraphs.original: πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε, τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες, σύμψυχοι, τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες,
paragraphs.translit: plērōsate mou tēn charan hina to auto phronēte, tēn autēn agapēn echontes, sympsychoi, to hen phronountes,

paragraphs.text: [doing] nothing through faction or through vainglory, but in lowliness of mind each counting other better than himself;
paragraphs.original: μηδὲν κατʼ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν, ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν,
paragraphs.translit: mēden katʼ eritheian mēde kata kenodoxian, alla tē tapeinophrosynē allēlous hēgoumenoi hyperechontas heautōn,

paragraphs.text: not looking each of you to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
paragraphs.original: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι.
paragraphs.translit: mē ta heautōn hekastoi skopountes, alla kai ta heterōn hekastoi.

paragraphs.text: Have this mind in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: touto phroneite en hymin ho kai en Christō Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: who, existing in the form of God, counted not the being on an equality with God a thing to be grasped,
paragraphs.original: ὃς ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων οὐχ ἁρπαγμὸν ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα θεῷ,
paragraphs.translit: hos en morphē theou hyparchōn ouch harpagmon hēgēsato to einai isa theō,

paragraphs.text: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men;
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος
paragraphs.translit: alla heauton ekenōsen morphēn doulou labōn, en homoiōmati anthrōpōn genomenos· kai schēmati heuretheis hōs anthrōpos

paragraphs.text: and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, becoming obedient [even] unto death, yea, the death of the cross.
paragraphs.original: ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου, θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ·
paragraphs.translit: etapeinōsen heauton genomenos hypēkoos mechri thanatou, thanatou de staurou·

paragraphs.text: Wherefore also God highly exalted him, and gave unto him the name which is above every name;
paragraphs.original: διὸ καὶ ὁ θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν, καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα,
paragraphs.translit: dio kai ho theos auton hyperypsōsen, kai echarisato autō to onoma to hyper pan onoma,

paragraphs.text: that in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of [things] in heaven and [things] on earth and [things] under the earth,
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων,
paragraphs.translit: hina en tō onomati Iēsou pan gony kampsē epouraniōn kai epigeiōn kai katachthoniōn,

paragraphs.text: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς εἰς δόξαν θεοῦ πατρός.
paragraphs.translit: kai pasa glōssa exomologēsētai hoti kyrios Iēsous Christos eis doxan theou patros.

paragraphs.text: So then, my beloved, even as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;
paragraphs.original: Ὥστε, ἀγαπητοί μου, καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε, μὴ ὡς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ μου μόνον ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ μου, μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου τὴν ἑαυτῶν σωτηρίαν κατεργάζεσθε,
paragraphs.translit: Hōste, agapētoi mou, kathōs pantote hypēkousate, mē hōs en tē parousia mou monon alla nyn pollō mallon en tē apousia mou, meta phobou kai tromou tēn heautōn sōtērian katergazesthe,

paragraphs.text: for it is God who worketh in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
paragraphs.original: θεὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας.
paragraphs.translit: theos gar estin ho energōn en hymin kai to thelein kai to energein hyper tēs eudokias.

paragraphs.text: Do all things without murmurings and questionings:
paragraphs.original: Πάντα ποιεῖτε χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: Panta poieite chōris gongysmōn kai dialogismōn,

paragraphs.text: that ye may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom ye are seen as lights in the world,
paragraphs.original: ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι, τέκνα θεοῦ ἄμωμα μέσον γενεᾶς σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης, ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ
paragraphs.translit: hina genēsthe amemptoi kai akeraioi, tekna theou amōma meson geneas skolias kai diestrammenēs, en hois phainesthe hōs phōstēres en kosmō

paragraphs.text: holding forth the word of life; that I may have whereof to glory in the day of Christ, that I did not run in vain neither labor in vain.
paragraphs.original: λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες, εἰς καύχημα ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα.
paragraphs.translit: logon zōēs epechontes, eis kauchēma emoi eis hēmeran Christou, hoti ouk eis kenon edramon oude eis kenon ekopiasa.

paragraphs.text: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all:
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ εἰ καὶ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ λειτουργίᾳ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, χαίρω καὶ συγχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν·
paragraphs.translit: alla ei kai spendomai epi tē thysia kai leitourgia tēs pisteōs hymōn, chairō kai synchairō pasin hymin·

paragraphs.text: and in the same manner do ye also joy, and rejoice with me.
paragraphs.original: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ καὶ ὑμεῖς χαίρετε καὶ συγχαίρετέ μοι.
paragraphs.translit: to de auto kai hymeis chairete kai synchairete moi.

paragraphs.text: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
paragraphs.original: Ἐλπίζω δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Τιμόθεον ταχέως πέμψαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Elpizō de en kyriō Iēsou Timotheon tacheōs pempsai hymin, hina kagō eupsychō gnous ta peri hymōn.

paragraphs.text: For I have no man likeminded, who will care truly for your state.
paragraphs.original: οὐδένα γὰρ ἔχω ἰσόψυχον ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει,
paragraphs.translit: oudena gar echō isopsychon hostis gnēsiōs ta peri hymōn merimnēsei,

paragraphs.text: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: οἱ πάντες γὰρ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ζητοῦσιν, οὐ τὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hoi pantes gar ta heautōn zētousin, ou ta Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a child [serveth] a father, [so] he served with me in furtherance of the gospel.
paragraphs.original: τὴν δὲ δοκιμὴν αὐτοῦ γινώσκετε, ὅτι ὡς πατρὶ τέκνον σὺν ἐμοὶ ἐδούλευσεν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον.
paragraphs.translit: tēn de dokimēn autou ginōskete, hoti hōs patri teknon syn emoi edouleusen eis to euangelion.

paragraphs.text: Him therefore I hope to send forthwith, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me:
paragraphs.original: τοῦτον μὲν οὖν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ ἐξαυτῆς·
paragraphs.translit: touton men oun elpizō pempsai hōs an aphidō ta peri eme exautēs·

paragraphs.text: but I trust in the Lord that I myself also shall come shortly.
paragraphs.original: πέποιθα δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι καὶ αὐτὸς ταχέως ἐλεύσομαι.
paragraphs.translit: pepoitha de en kyriō hoti kai autos tacheōs eleusomai.

paragraphs.text: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker and fellow-soldier, and your messenger and minister to my need;
paragraphs.original: Ἀναγκαῖον δὲ ἡγησάμην Ἐπαφρόδιτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συνεργὸν καὶ συστρατιώτην μου, ὑμῶν δὲ ἀπόστολον καὶ λειτουργὸν τῆς χρείας μου, πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: Anankaion de hēgēsamēn Epaphroditon ton adelphon kai synergon kai systratiōtēn mou, hymōn de apostolon kai leitourgon tēs chreias mou, pempsai pros hymas,

paragraphs.text: since he longed after you all, and was sore troubled, because ye had heard that he was sick:
paragraphs.original: ἐπειδὴ ἐπιποθῶν ἦν πάντας ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἀδημονῶν διότι ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἠσθένησεν.
paragraphs.translit: epeidē epipothōn ēn pantas hymas, kai adēmonōn dioti ēkousate hoti ēsthenēsen.

paragraphs.text: for indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ἠσθένησεν παραπλήσιον θανάτῳ· ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς ἠλέησεν αὐτόν, οὐκ αὐτὸν δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ, ἵνα μὴ λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην σχῶ.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar ēsthenēsen paraplēsion thanatō· alla ho theos ēleēsen auton, ouk auton de monon alla kai eme, hina mē lypēn epi lypēn schō.

paragraphs.text: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
paragraphs.original: σπουδαιοτέρως οὖν ἔπεμψα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ἀλυπότερος ὦ.
paragraphs.translit: spoudaioterōs oun epempsa auton hina idontes auton palin charēte kagō alypoteros ō.

paragraphs.text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy; and hold such in honor:
paragraphs.original: προσδέχεσθε οὖν αὐτὸν ἐν κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς, καὶ τοὺς τοιούτους ἐντίμους ἔχετε,
paragraphs.translit: prosdechesthe oun auton en kyriō meta pasēs charas, kai tous toioutous entimous echete,

paragraphs.text: because for the work of Christ he came nigh unto death, hazarding his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν, παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας.
paragraphs.translit: hoti dia to ergon Christou mechri thanatou ēngisen, paraboleusamenos tē psychē hina anaplērōsē to hymōn hysterēma tēs pros me leitourgias.
